section: Sikhism - the ten Gurus, Guru Granth Sahib, the Khalsa; Banda Bahadur and Ranjit Singh

accepted.s: Akal Takht sought re-amendment of which of the following Acts in 2026 in connection with preventing sacrilege?
o: Jaagat Jot Sri Guru Granth Sahib Satkar (Amendment) Act, 2026
accepted.x: Akal Takht asked for the re-amendment of the Jaagat Jot Sri Guru Granth Sahib Satkar (Amendment) Act, 2026. The measure is associated with preventing sacrilege of the Sikh scripture.
accepted.tq: Use the exact official title and distinguish it from closely related Sikh religious terms.

accepted.s: The Jaagat Jot Sri Guru Granth Sahib Satkar (Amendment) Act, 2026 was passed unanimously on which date?
accepted.x: The Act was passed unanimously on 13 April 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate closely placed dates by linking each date to its specific event.

accepted.s: The 350th martyrdom year of Guru Tegh Bahadur was observed in which year?
accepted.x: The 350th martyrdom year of Guru Tegh Bahadur was observed in 2026.
accepted.tq: Treat the year as the decisive numerical detail and eliminate adjacent-year distractors.

accepted.s: Sirhind Fateh Diwas in 2026 was observed from
accepted.x: Sirhind Fateh Diwas was observed from 12 to 14 May 2026.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between overlapping date ranges by checking both the starting and ending dates.

accepted.s: Who among the following paid tribute at Hazur Sahib, Nanded, during the Shaheedi Samagam on 26 January 2026?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan paid tribute at Hazur Sahib, Nanded, during the Shaheedi Samagam.
accepted.tq: Match the contemporary public figure with the specific place and occasion.

accepted.s: Who established the first sovereign Sikh state at Sirhind in 1710?
accepted.x: Banda Bahadur established the first sovereign Sikh state at Sirhind in 1710.
accepted.tq: Use the founder–achievement–place–year combination to avoid ruler and leader swaps.

accepted.s: Who was the last Sikh ruler?
accepted.x: Duleep Singh was the last Sikh ruler.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the last ruler from earlier Sikh leaders and founders by focusing on the succession endpoint.
